name: Mikro MSC Berhad
summary: Mikro MSC Berhad, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, and sale of analogue, digital, and computer controlled electronic systems or devices. The company offers combined overcurrent and earth fault, earth leakage, voltage, reverse power, and motor protection relays; and earth leakage systems, power factor regulators, annunciators, capacitors and reactors, and digital power meters.
